Game Overview

Super Slime Smash is a ninja title where unleash your inner slime warrior in Super Slime Smash. Dive into chaotic battles with quirky, gelatinous foes, using nimble platforming and inventive slime-jitsu tactics. Experience charming pixel graphics, intuitive controls, and non-stop action as you dodge, jump, and dispatch enemies with pinpoint shuriken accuracy. Conquer the slime invasion!
